loading.title: Check this phone
loading.body: Buckspay reads your wallet connection and this phone’s registration on Solana.

unreachable.title: Can’t reach Solana
unreachable.body: Buckspay needs a connection to read this phone’s registration on Solana.

connect.title: Connect your wallet
connect.body: Buckspay pays from, and credits to, a wallet you already use. Connecting shares its address and costs nothing.

create-key.title: Create this phone’s key
create-key.body: A key made in this phone's secure hardware approves your payments. It never leaves the phone.

activate.title: Add funds
activate.body: Your funds go into a reserve that backs what you pay. Activating links this phone to your wallet publicly and permanently. Anyone can see the link on Solana, and it can't be undone.

other-wallet.title: Registered to another wallet
other-wallet.body: This phone is permanently linked to the wallet below. Connect that wallet to pay and receive on this phone.

shortfall: Your wallet has {{sol}} SOL. Add SOL to it before you activate.
sponsorshipUnavailable: Buckspay can’t pay for activations right now, so your wallet pays the network costs.

confirmingNotice.sent: Sent to Solana. Waiting for confirmation, usually under a minute. You can leave this screen; this can’t be cancelled.
confirmingNotice.unknown: Your wallet may have sent the activation. Waiting until Solana confirms it or it expires, usually under a minute. You can leave this screen.

softwareKeyWarning: This phone keeps its key in software, where malware can reach it more easily than in secure hardware.

unreachable.title: Can’t reach Solana
unreachable.body: Buckspay couldn’t read this phone’s registration. Check your connection.

ready.title: This phone is registered to your wallet

confirming.title: Activating this phone
confirming.body: Waiting for Solana to confirm it, usually under a minute.

otherWallet.title: Registered to another wallet
otherWallet.body: Connect the wallet this phone is linked to, to pay and receive.

reconnect.title: Reconnect your wallet to pay
reconnect.body: This phone is registered. Connect the wallet it is linked to.

setup.title: Set up payments
setup.body: Paying and receiving need a wallet and this phone’s key, registered on Solana.

viewTransaction: View the transaction in the explorer
